name: Structured, flexible, and robust benchmark
description: A new challenge benchmark for comparing humans and distributional large language models on out-of-distribution reasoning tasks, specifically in planning and explanation generation domains, designed to test generalization to new problems expressed in language.
reputation: A niche research benchmark that is cited for studying out-of-distribution reasoning and structured generalization, but it is not a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark designed to require generalization to out-of-distribution problems; includes two problem-solving domains.
